title: Minigame: A10.531 Open Ground

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as a minigame of the Rules-first plan (the A10.531 claim): a German squad crossing open ground, grain, and a hedged road in view of a Russian squad, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, a German squad and a Good Order Russian squad within 16 hexes of it.

introduction: A squad crosses open ground, grain, and a hedged road in front of the enemy: where is it in Open Ground, and to whom?

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
